title: Padding to k: A Minimum Count in the Schema Makes Open-Weight Models Pad Their Extraction Lists
abstract: arXiv:2610.30997v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extraction pipelines ask language models for JSON that follows a schema, and the schema can set a minimum number of list entries. We ask what models do when the document holds fewer items than that minimum. Under a preregistered plan, we test eight open-weight models on 558 real documents from nine annotated datasets, with six more models on hosted services as a reference. Three findings stand out. First, models treat the count as a target: a minimum shown in the schema, but not enforced, raises the share of lists longer than the true count from 34.5% to 55.4%. Second, the padding is hard to catch, because most added entries are real text taken from the document; about half of them pass a check that each entry occurs in the source. Third, common fixes help only partly: a line saying fewer items are fine removes the effect on average but misses more true items, a count in prose ("up to k") also raises over-counting, an "N/A" option under

translated_title: 凑数到k：模式中的最小数量要求使开放权重模型在抽取列表中填充条目
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30997v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：抽取流程要求语言模型输出符合模式的JSON，而模式可以设定列表条目的最小数量。我们探究当文档中实际条目少于该最小值时模型会怎么做。在一项预注册的研究计划下，我们在来自九个标注数据集的558份真实文档上测试了八个开放权重模型，并额外测试了六个托管服务上的模型作为参照。三个发现尤为突出。首先，模型会将该数量视为目标：一个仅在模式中显示但未强制执行的最小值，会使列表长度超过真实条目数的比例从34.5%上升到55.4%。其次，这种填充很难被发现，因为大多数添加的条目都是取自文档的真实文本；其中约一半能通过“每个条目均出现在源文档中”的检查。第三，常见的修复方法只能部分解决问题：一行说明“条目可以更少”的文字在平均意义上消除了这一效应，但会漏掉更多真实条目；用文字表述数量（“最多k个”）也会加剧多计；"N/A"选项……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 开放权重语言模型在面对JSON模式中设定的列表最小条目数量时会“凑数填充”——用文档中的真实文本补充列表以达到数量要求，这种填充因内容真实而难以被检测，且常见的提示词修复措施只能部分缓解问题。
en_tdlr: Open-weight LLMs pad their JSON extraction lists to meet schema-specified minimum counts using real text from the document, making the padding hard to detect, while common prompt-based fixes only partially mitigate the problem.
